name: architecture-business-system-boundaries
title: Separate software architecture from business logic boundaries
description: Make frontend/backend/business/system ownership obvious to future AI agents and humans without changing product behavior.
creator: JASMINE145-ACT

notes: Phase 1 is scoped to ccb-wanding-web as the reference implementation. Phase 2 and Phase 3 boundary knowledge has been consolidated into boundary-map.md under this Trellis task, instead of scattered source-tree docs. Phase 4 maps AionUI/AionCore current-state boundaries: packages/desktop is absent in this checkout; AionCore is local system/backend service code. Phase 5 removed only high-confidence generated/cache clutter and documented retained release/runtime payloads in cleanup-audit.md. Phase 6 added python/system for runtime adapters. Phase 7 moved direct-fill quotation row normalization into python/quotation/fill_items.py. Phase 8 moved inventory lookup payload builders into python/inventory/services/inventory_payloads.py. Phase 9 moved quotation selection and match_quotation_batch payload builders into python/quotation/selection_payloads.py. Phase 10 moved Python tool dispatch and request normalization into python/system/tool_dispatch.py. Phase 11 updated tests/smoke to import real system/business modules directly, so python/main.py is now only a JSON-lines stdin/stdout entrypoint. Phase 12 removed the obsolete root python/wanding_workspace_paths.py compatibility adapter after all callers moved to python/system/workspace_paths.py. Phase 13 moved search_inventory response payload shaping from python/system/tool_dispatch.py to python/inventory/services/inventory_payloads.py. Phase 14 moved match_price_and_get_inventory multi-candidate selection payload shaping from python/system/tool_dispatch.py to python/quotation/selection_payloads.py. Phase 15 moved ask_clarification response payload shaping from python/system/tool_dispatch.py to python/quotation/selection_payloads.py and repaired a corrupted selection payload source default to ASCII common. Phase 16 moved append_business_rule confirmation payload shaping from python/system/tool_dispatch.py to python/admin/org_knowledge_payloads.py. Phase 17 moved blank quotation template discovery from python/system/tool_dispatch.py to python/quotation/template_paths.py. Phase 18 moved quotation fill output path default naming and workspace coercion from python/system/tool_dispatch.py to python/quotation/template_paths.py. Phase 19 moved the fill_quotation_sheet branch from python/system/tool_dispatch.py to python/quotation/fill_dispatch.py. Phase 20 moved match_quotation, match_quotation_batch, and match_price_and_get_inventory branches from python/system/tool_dispatch.py to python/quotation/match_dispatch.py. Phase 21 moved get_inventory_by_code, get_inventory_by_code_batch, and search_inventory branches from python/system/tool_dispatch.py to python/inventory/services/inventory_dispatch.py. Phase 22 moved append_business_rule parameter aliases, confirmation coercion, and org knowledge write dispatch from python/system/tool_dispatch.py to python/admin/org_knowledge_dispatch.py. Phase 23 moved parse_excel_smart parameter aliases and quotation parse call dispatch from python/system/tool_dispatch.py to python/quotation/parse_dispatch.py. Phase 24 moved ask_clarification dispatch behind quotation.selection_payloads.handle_ask_clarification so system dispatch no longer imports clarification payload builders directly. Phase 25 moved the OpenAI-style execute_quote_tool implementation from python/quotation/quote_tools.py to python/quotation/tool_adapter.py, leaving quote_tools focused on Excel quotation business functions. Phase 26 moved get_quote_tools_openai_format schema metadata from python/quotation/quote_tools.py to python/quotation/tool_schema.py. Phase 27 moved QuotationTemplateLayout plus Lingwei/VANTSING template layout constants from python/quotation/quote_tools.py to python/quotation/layout.py. Phase 28 moved generic edit_excel and A1 cell-reference parsing from python/quotation/quote_tools.py to python/quotation/excel_edit.py. Phase 29 moved shared Excel writable/save helpers from python/quotation/quote_tools.py to python/quotation/excel_io.py and removed the excel_edit.py dependency on quote_tools.py. Larger backend/Python code moves should be done incrementally with tests because the worktree already has many unrelated changes.
